issue_context.title: Light group no longer shows dimmer control in 2021.5.0
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I have two dimmer lights, which are both operating correctly.  Both of these lights are in a group.  Prior to 2021.5.0 upgrade, this group showed the dimmer control and I was able to control both lights by adjusting the dimmer control of the group.  After the 2021.5.0 upgrade, this group no longer shows the dimmer control
```
light:
  - platform: group
    name: Bedroom lights
    entities:
      - light.dimmer_1
      - light.dimmer_2
```

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.5.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2021.4.2

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Core

### Integration causing the issue

Light Group

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/light.group/

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
light:
  - platform: group
    name: Bedroom lights
    entities:
      - light.dimmer_1
      - light.dimmer_2
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
None
```


### Additional information

![light group](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6196195/117254604-81938200-ae40-11eb-98e7-c9eb14de11fe.jpg)

Yes, please also collect a log which covers you turning on and off the individual lights in the group, as well as the group, with these settings:
```yaml
logger:
  default: info
  logs:
    homeassistant.core: debug
```

As an alternative, you can use the "states" developer tool and get screenshots with the individual lights and the group on and off.
Hi, I enabled the log, but am not seeing anything relating to the lights going on or off. Screen shots of the states are below.

Aaah all your lights support `color_modes`, however, the light groups (at this point) only look at `supported_features` (which is 0 for lights in color mode).

Thus the group ends up having `supported_features=0`, which is on/off only.

The light group needs to learn to aggregate the `color_modes` as well (just like it does for `supported_features`)

Needs adjustment in `group/light::async_update()`

with shelly dimmer, there was a larger selection before the update, such as dimming down and dimming up.
these have disappeared.
